verdict.rationale: The only first-party material on this topic comes from the spec. It notes that skills can bundle scripts and defines an experimental `allowed-tools` frontmatter field for pre-approved tools, which loosely addresses what skills can execute. Telemetry is described only by community commenters, who say leaderboard ranking comes from anonymous telemetry on `npx skills add`; the project's own docs in this pack do not disclose it. Missing for 10: a documented trust or verification model for third-party skills, first-party telemetry and data-collection disclosure with opt-out, a non-experimental execution or sandboxing policy, and any dedicated security documentation.
